# ernestocisneros.art — LLM Context

> Ernesto Cisneros Cino is a Cuban composer, pianist, digital artist, and writer based in Miami.
> This site is his complete artistic and intellectual archive.

## Site Sections
- /music — Albums: Mare Incognitum, Glacial Paths, Atlas of Fragmented Light, Sandbank, Trash, Velvet Alloy, and earlier works
- /ideas — Essays on cosmology, philosophy, technology, culture, and the Cuba series
- /nft — Digital art collections on Ethereum and Tezos blockchains
- /books — Published books: Sombras Datos y Relámpagos, La Sospecha Razonable, Huella, La Necesidad de Creer
- /biography — Full biography and collaborations
- /impulses-art — Music therapy for refugees, families, and vulnerable communities in Miami, Florida
- /contact — Contact information

## Languages
The site is available in 7 languages: EN (default), ES, FR, IT, JA, KO, RU.
Content is localized, not machine-translated.

## Structured Data
All pages include JSON-LD schemas (Person, MusicAlbum, Article, CollectionPage, etc.)
